title: Premium payment event
description: Canonical, provider-independent representation of a premium payment notification (FR2), published to the Service Bus topic premium-payments. Version 1.0. Versioning: a minor version (1.0 -> 1.1) only adds optional fields or enum values, and consumers must ignore fields they do not know; any other change is a new major version with a new $id. The event never carries payer personal data (NFR6).

eventId.description: Business event ID, stable across provider retries. Used for deduplication and as the Service Bus MessageId. Quetzal: QZ:{id}. Andina: AND:{transaccion.id}:{transaccion.estado}. Austral: AUS:{eventId}.

correlationId.description: ID of the request that produced the event, assigned by the API Manager (NFR7).

paymentKey.description: Payment identifier: provider prefix + provider transaction ID. Equals Payment_Key__c in Salesforce and is the Service Bus SessionId.

provider.description: Payment provider that sent the notification.

country.description: Country of the payment, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

providerTransactionId.description: The provider's charge, transaction or payment ID.

providerEventId.description: The provider's ID for this notification, for support requests with the provider. For Andina it changes on every retry.

status.description: Canonical payment status. PARTIALLY_REFUNDED is written to Salesforce as Captured (assumption 7).

statusChangedAt.description: Time of the state change at the provider, ISO-8601 in UTC.

amount.description: Amount in the currency's major unit, as a decimal string with the number of decimals defined by ISO 4217 (MXN and COP: 2, CLP: 0), with at most 14 integer digits, as Salesforce Amount__c (Currency(16, 2)). A string avoids floating-point errors.

refundedAmount.description: Refunded amount, same format as amount. Required for REFUNDED and PARTIALLY_REFUNDED, not allowed otherwise.

paymentMethod.description: Type of payment method only (for example card or PSE). Never a token or card data.

receivedAt.description: Time the intake received the notification, ISO-8601 in UTC.
